## Description and Rationale

Independent researcher working on operational forecasting for aviation
from open data. I run a live, continuously published forward record of
GNSS interference built from open ADS-B integrity signals, scored daily
against independent sources, with each forecast cryptographically
timestamped before its outcome is known.

Taxi-out is the same problem in a different layer — a short-horizon
operational forecast over open trajectory data, where the difficulty is
proving the evaluation is honest rather than fitting the model. I am
registering to test that methodology against an external scoreboard and
to contribute the leakage-control tooling back openly.
